seasonRead.headline: 2014–15: The forward pool is split between pace and resistance
paragraphs: Rush / Transition Chance Creator owns the clearest attacking brief. Its shot and continuation signals read like a role built to carry possession into the next phase and generate attempts before the defense can reset.

Shot-Blocking Contact Specialist is less a hitting identity than a defensive-detail one, with blocks and takeaways doing the separating. High-Touch Risk/Reward Scorer supplies the higher-touch bridge between those poles, which is the kind of role balance a coach can turn into coherent lines.

seasonRead.headline: 2014–15: Transport and containment divide the workload
paragraphs: Offensive Puck-Moving Defenseman and Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman form a sharp specialization spectrum: one is associated with assists, points and team offense; the other with blocks and repeated defensive-zone labor.

Defensive Role Defenseman fills most of the remaining space as a lower-creation role. The blue-line question is not which label is best in isolation, but whether each pair has a way to move the puck when containment finally wins it back.
